name: Cyclofenil

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in France, first in 1987 — for liver harm

similar.name: Oxyphenisatin Acetate
problems: Pulled from the market in United States and 18 other countries, first in 1970 — for liver harm

similar.name: Triacetyldiphenolisatin
problems: Pulled from the market in Australia and 3 other countries, first in 1971 — for liver harm

similar.name: Estradiol Acetate
problems: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for blood vessel problems, heart harm and nerve and brain harm

summary: Cyclofenil was pulled from the market in France starting in 1987 due to liver harm [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave the drug low scores for liver and heart harm [M]. Several similar drugs were pulled from markets in the United States and other countries for liver harm, or carry boxed warnings for vascular, heart, and nerve damage [4][5][6].
